entity_note: IONOS Group SE was carved out of United Internet's Business Applications segment and listed on 8 February 2023. United Internet AG remains the majority shareholder, so the parent and the cloud arm are both separately reported and the parent figure already contains the cloud figure.

parent.name: United Internet AG
parent.relationship: Majority shareholder of IONOS Group SE; IONOS is fully consolidated into United Internet's accounts.

proxy.label: United Internet Business Applications segment
proxy.explanation: The segment IONOS was carved out of. It neither contains IONOS Group SE nor sits inside it: in 2020, where both are published, the segment reports 948.6 against IONOS Group SE's 988.3. The two are differently drawn businesses, so this figure says nothing about how large or small IONOS is.
proxy.in_plain_words: a differently drawn business; it says nothing about the cloud arm's size

europe.measure: domestic (German) revenue as a share of segment revenue
europe.note: United Internet splits revenue into domestic and foreign, not into Europe and the rest. Its foreign revenue mixes European countries with the United States, where IONOS Inc. operates out of Philadelphia, so no European share can be read off it. What the split does establish is that Germany alone accounts for around nine tenths of revenue, so the European share is at least that. The chart shows it as a floor rather than as a value.

notes: Two different perimeters exist for the years before 2020 and must not be mixed. IONOS Group SE first reports its own revenue for 2020. For 2016 to 2019 the nearest published series is United Internet's Business Applications segment, carried here in a separate 'predecessor_segment' field, never in the 'cloud' field.

Even in 2020, where both exist, the two differ: IONOS Group SE reports 988.3 while United Internet's Business Applications segment reports 948.6. The perimeters are not identical, which is the reason the two are kept apart.

IONOS classified its AdTech division as a discontinued operation under IFRS 5 as of 30 September 2025 and restated 2024. The 2024 row therefore carries both figures: 1,560.3 as originally reported and 1,248.1 restated. A chart that plots 1,560.3 for 2024 next to 1,316.9 for 2025 shows a fall that is an accounting reclassification, not a loss of business.
United Internet's 2024 sales of 5,990.8 are the comparable figure stated in the 2025 annual report, which is why 2023 (6,185.9) is higher.
Business Applications segment revenue for 2015 was not found in the 2019 or 2020 annual reports, whose multi-period tables begin at 2016.
